title: JI and Government Nearing Deal on Petrol Relief
excerpt: Jamaat-e-Islami and the federal government have reached a broad agreement on a draft aimed at providing petrol relief.
body_html:
Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) and the federal government have made progress in their discussions regarding relief measures for fuel.

Both sides have successfully agreed on the broad outlines of a draft agreement aimed at providing petrol relief. Further details regarding the implementation and finalization of the pact are expected as negotiations continue.
